voice.steering: Speak in a solemn 19th-century documentary voice.

world_anchor: 1860s American Civil War, Matthew Brady tintype archival photograph
style_block: Authentic 1860s tintype wet plate photograph, sepia monochrome tone, subtle silver halide grain, historically accurate Union and Confederate uniforms, period rifles.
negative_block: No modern objects, no plastic, no 20th century firearms, no text, no watermark, no signature, no logo.

wet_plate.prompt: Wet-plate collodion field photograph, shallow tonal range, edge vignetting, period uniform detail.

battlefield_reportage.prompt: Restrained battlefield reportage, overcast light, mud and smoke, no heroic posing.

lithograph.prompt: Period lithograph or steel engraving, cross-hatched shading, muted ink wash.

campfire_silhouette.prompt: Silhouetted figures around a campfire against a dusk treeline.

letters_collage.prompt: Collage of folded letters, ration tickets and tintypes on worn linen.
